title: Hungary’s new government claws back motorways and tobacco monopoly after years of taxpayer‑funded Orbán luxury travel (Day 191 of the Tisza government)
lede: Hungary’s new leaders rip up motorway and tobacco deals that once enriched Orbán’s allies, raising the prospect of a massive financial and political reckoning.

title: UK-EU summit to see mutual love-bombing, but British must decide what to do next
lede: There will be agreements aplenty in Brussels on Friday, but the UK needs to decide how ambitious its plans for closer integration with the EU will be.
